services.desc: Camps are one week and each day is filled with activities, games and excercises that will keep students engaged and active. Teamwork, problem solving and fun culminates in a recital or presentation for family. Summer is full of lots of things to do, vacations, the pool, holidays, other camp offerings and so much more. We want to be a part of your child’s summer experience. Camps are held at the Studio and the Main Theatre. blurb: Harper Lee’s masterwork comes to life in this powerful adaptation of To Kill a Mockingbird. Set in the racially charged Deep South of the 1930s, this gripping drama follows young Scout Finch as she witnesses her father, Atticus Finch, take a stand for justice in a world steeped in prejudice.
